resources.string: The address of the Pi on the home network. The port is 8000 unless you type another one.
Cannot reach the Pi at %1$s.\n\nThis app works only on the home Wi-Fi. Check the Wi-Fi and press Open to try again, or change the address if the Pi has a new one.
To come back to this screen later, press and hold the app icon and choose \"Pi address\".
